title: Implement exact VND money, duration, and rounding primitives
goal: Use test-driven development to create the smallest deterministic payroll-domain primitives for exact VND arithmetic, validated minute durations, and named rounding, with focused RED/GREEN evidence and no floating-point storage.

model_route.fallback: none; stop and report if the requested model or reasoning effort is unavailable

prerequisites: PAY-W0-01 passed and commit 16afd9ff746fbfce53899d6fd9f5b1292efd7f7a is the W1 base
decimal.js 10.6.0 is installed as an exact dependency of @pay-slip/payroll-domain
fast-check 4.9.0 is installed as an exact root development dependency
Duke separately approves one Hermes gpt-5.6-terra xhigh invocation and the focused RED/GREEN test plus typecheck commands before execution starts

parent_owned_preexisting_changes.rule: Do not edit, stage, revert, delete, regenerate, or claim ownership of any parent-owned preexisting change. Re-hash the three immutable files before handoff and stop if any hash differs.

excluded_scope: PAY-W1-02 or any legal rule-pack, PIT, insurance, overtime, public-holiday, or deduction logic
Apps, database, Prisma, API, authentication, attendance, UI, PDF, delivery, backup, or production work
Real employee, attendance, payroll, contract, credential, or secret data
Git branch creation, staging, commit, push, reset, checkout, deletion, or history mutation

required: multiplyRateByMinutes(rate: Vnd, minutes: Minutes, rule: RoundingRule): Vnd
behavior: minutes(-1) throws an error containing DURATION_NEGATIVE
Decimal.js is used only inside arithmetic and conversion to bigint occurs exactly once at a named rounding boundary
Unsafe JavaScript number conversion is rejected rather than silently rounded
Any VND serialization surface introduced by this task uses base-10 strings
Stored or returned VND values do not use floating point

Create the two focused test files first, run the exact focused unit-test command, and preserve evidence that failure is caused by missing PAY-W1-01 exports or behavior rather than configuration, dependency, or environment failure.
Create the four source files with the minimum exact implementation, rerun the focused tests, then run the approved root typecheck.
Inspect the scoped diff, run git diff --check, re-hash parent-owned files, write and parse the structured handoff, then stop.
